name: Sample: enterprise
description: A sample template for a larger organisation: role groups per team (internal IT, management, developers, security operations, an external support partner), task and service groups for Entra ID, Azure, Defender XDR, Intune and on-premises AD, administrative units per level, and the delegations between them. Import the permission packs entra-roles, entra-roles-reference and defender-xdr first: this sample nests their groups. Replace the example management group names (they start with mg-) with your own.
